text_block_list.text:
One winter day. On the way back from 
shopping with Duramente in the commercial 
district...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Look at that.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Looks like this is where we use the 
lottery ticket we got earlier.

When I went shopping earlier, the 
shopkeeper gave me a raffle ticket and 
told me where it was being held.
choice_data_list: So you were interested in the raffle, huh.
So you were interested in the raffle, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Rather than interest, it's more like...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It would be rude to disregard a gift given 
to me with such thought.

It seems that rather than an interest in 
the lottery itself, it was out of a sense 
of obligation to the shopkeeper—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"So... if I recall, I'm supposed to turn 
that lever, right?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Can I start doing it now?

—Or so it seemed, but that wasn't quite 
the case.

Looking somewhat restless, Duramente spun 
the lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is this supposed to be amazing?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is it really worthy of such celebration?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Well then, I will gratefully accept.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't have to be so formal... Though 
it really is a wonderful hot spring!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood.
choice_data_list: Is this a place you know?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Members of my clan frequent that 
place as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
After major turning points like national 
or world championships, many people visit 
for both rest and reward.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I always thought that once I achieved 
something, I'd like to pay a visit there 
someday.
choice_data_list: ...Then, how about I hold onto it for you?
...Then, shall I hold onto it for you?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, quite strict, aren't you, Trainer? 
Saying it's still too early for her?
choice_data_list:
Because I think she herself feels that 
way.

text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I think she's working hard, and 
I feel she has already achieved things. 
But unless she herself is satisfied, it 
means nothing.

"Right now, she probably isn't capable of 
relaxing her shoulders and unwinding. In 
that case—"
choice_data_list:
I'll stick with you all the way until that 
day comes.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I want you to hold 
onto this for me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Until I prove "who I am"... I can't afford 
to stop running.

And so, it was decided that I would hold 
onto the winning hot springs trip ticket 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"This Salisbury steak... It looks 
familiar..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...When I was a child, there was a period 
where I temporarily had to follow a rather 
strict dietary restriction."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, there was a good reason for it, 
but for a young girl like me, it was 
agonizing...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I accidentally let 
it slip to Dad, saying, "I just want to 
eat as much of my favorite foods as I 
like."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how pained my dad looked right 
then... I realized I had said something 
awful.
choice_data_list:
You probably really wanted to let them do 
that.

You probably really wanted to let them do 
that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I understand now. But back then...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thinking I had disappointed them, I didn't 
make any more selfish demands.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
After the dietary restrictions ended... I 
saw my father cooking his heart out.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
What was completed was an absurdly 
large... giant two-tiered hamburger steak.
choice_data_list: Does that resemble this hamburger steak?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Cutting carrots was too hard, so I 
just stabbed them... My father laughed as 
he told that story.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It looks similar... to that Salisbury 
steak as big as my face back then.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
When Dad wryly laughed saying how clumsy 
it looked, I shook my head so hard I 
almost got dizzy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"...What an aaaabsolutely wonderful story! 
*Waaaaahhh!!*"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Even you... !?

—Apparently, after eating the Salisbury 
steak, Duramente ended up calling her 
parents. She told me about it later, 
looking a bit embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...That's a lot.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's our spirit! Having a party 
with friends is great, but giving it as a 
gift to someone you're grateful to is a 
solid choice too!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The person who helped me...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Groove-san! There are two carrots 
lying on the floor in front of the room, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A carrot...? Did someone drop this? I have 
no idea what the situation is here, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see, it just says: 'To my 
dearest Air Groove-sama'... and nothing 
else."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Let me see it. I have an idea."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Could it be that Groove-san has 
finally...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. âThis is mere 
child's play.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, "all right"?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What are you, some trickster fox from a 
folktale?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd come tonight as well. 
...Why not hand it over directly?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove is probably busy. Besides, 
there are still plenty of carrots left.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I thought taking them all at once would 
cause an inconvenience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So you're telling me you went all the way 
to the other dorm and carried them over 
here bit by bit?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking back now, perhaps that was 
rude of me. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what am I going to do with 
you... Why do you never do the most 
obvious thing first?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We shall eat them together. You can tell 
me why you bought so many carrots then.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! Big Sis Groove and...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...Yes! Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, snack time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Carrots contain numerous nutrients. They 
are low in calories, and munching on them 
raw provides high satiety.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect for a snack, wouldn't you say? I 
often nibble on them myself."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"If you especially want to absorb 
beta-carotene, it is more effective when 
combined with fats."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: My recommendation is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —These are carrots roasted in olive oil.
choice_data_list: It's so piping hot and delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Right? It brings out the natural sweetness 
of the carrots, too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This is my reward treat. I'm glad to 
see... it suited your taste as well.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Eep... Did I make you mad? I-I'm kinda 
sorry...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! No, I was just... thinking it was pocket 
tissue, that's all—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that so...? Sorry about that, 
mister here jumped to his own conclusions.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...No, I should apologize for staring so 
impolitely.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really that frightening?

Duramente felt downcast, though for a 
reason entirely unrelated to drawing a 
miss...
